invariants.rationale: The method always returns the result of HoodieJavaTable.create(...) which should be non-null unless an exception is thrown.
config is passed into method and directly used; it must be non-null to safely access its methods.
context is used to call context.getStorageConf().newInstance(); cannot be null at this program point.
Factory-style methods typically associate the configuration passed in with the created object, and HoodieJavaTable likely stores or exposes its config.
HoodieJavaTable is constructed with the context parameter, so it is likely to hold a reference to it.
